specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Đọc file Rhino .3dm (NURBS/trimmed BRep, layers, units, blocks, meshes), chuyển sang scene OCCT, giao dịch atomic; lệnh Import được gắn qua File Menu Matrix.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tự xây menu File thứ hai; không cam kết khôi phục userdata proprietary của Matrix/Clayoo.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “.3dm NURBS Surface And Trimmed B-Rep” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

technical_decisions: Xác minh ONX_Model::Read / ON_BinaryFile tại revision openNURBS đã pin trước khi chọn API C++; không suy đoán Rust crate .3dm có sẵn.
Thiết kế bridge Rust↔C++: ownership ONX_Model, memory release, string ABI, exception→Result; không unwind qua extern C.
Bảo toàn object id, layer, units, hidden/locked và warning unsupported; import là một transaction với rollback và metrics trước/sau.
Đối chiếu binary 3DM bằng fixtures nguồn có thể tái lập; báo BLOCKED_FIXTURE nếu thiếu tệp thực; không coi mock JSON là import proof.
Đọc ON_Brep, ON_BrepFace, ON_BrepTrim, ON_BrepLoop, ON_NurbsSurface; phân biệt 3D curves với 2D p-curves trên mặt.
Dựng OCCT Geom_BSplineSurface/Geom2d_BSplineCurve từ knots/multiplicities/weights, sau đó wires & face orientation; test BRepCheck_Analyzer.
Ghi báo cáo lossless/lossy rõ ràng: seam, trims, boundaries, units/tolerance, closedness và đối chiếu diện tích/thể tích.

input.purpose: preserve trimmed surface, polysurface and solid boundaries
input.fixture_class: openNURBS V5/V6/V7/V8 synthetic 3dm; source unit in mm/inch; no privileged plugin userdata

positive.setup: Use fixed .3dm fixture with source object IDs, a layer, units and any NURBS trims required by this task.
positive.expected: NURBS degree/knots/weights plus oriented UV trim loops preserved in OCCT BRep with IsValid and open/closed classification.

negative.setup: Truncated 3dm input with bad version/chunk, unsupported userdata or invalid trim.
negative.expected: Import aborts atomically or skips explicitly with warnings according to policy; no half-created document.

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.positive_assertions: valid OCCT Face with p-curves and trimmed loop orientation; area/holes checked
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: reversed trim edge, seam mismatch, missing surface or loop

retained_definition_source_baselines_202.limitations: Old definition baselines remain display-sensitive; older-binary compatibility and actual native displayed-member export remain unverified.

retained_source_baselines_2026_11_14.limitations: Native fixture import passed but its B-rep was retained-only; real 3DM remesh/export, nested definition fingerprints, older-binary forward compatibility and v5 remain unverified.

runtime_implementation.trim_native_headroom_2026_11_13: Conversion of tested large trim requests estimated native headroom before OCCT; constrained-memory 1024-edge host fixture preserves destination/document/Redo and retries. Estimate does not bound native allocations. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-12-trimmed-surface-stl-gap.md#estimated-native-headroom-for-large-trim-export
runtime_implementation.trim_3dm_1024_2026_11_13: Tested reopened plane with hole and 1024 trim edges roundtrips through admitted 3DM host and actual debug executable; material/hole/exterior rays checked. Independent Rhino, arbitrary geometry and native peak unverified. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-12-trimmed-surface-stl-gap.md#export-up-to-1024-polygon-edges

large_trim_support_2026_11_13.scope: A 28x28 planar trimmed surface with a hole and metadata over 16 KiB now fits the separate default 128 KiB trim limit. Tested insertion and Undo/Redo, OM9 save/open, scene picking and incremental update, ExtractWireframe and isocurve after reopen, STL and real 3DM export/reimport. Other names and extension limits remain separate; managed-pressure refusal preserves document/Redo in the wireframe fixture.
large_trim_support_2026_11_13.remaining: Older builds can reject files with trim metadata over 16 KiB. Arbitrary trim topology, physical OOM, native peak, independent Rhino and desktop remain open. The debug native adapter still rejects the packet schema; Plan A remains open.
large_trim_support_2026_11_13.next_action: Reconcile the debug native adapter without disrupting active user sessions, then verify the scoped workflow on desktop; continue Plan A remaining gates.

trim_source_consistency_2026_11_13.scope: Document validation now rejects a trim extension whose underlying geometry differs from the entity surface. The root-entity transaction fixture checks refusal preserves snapshot and Redo, and a synchronized geometry/trim edit succeeds with Undo/Redo; archive save refuses the invalid document without overwriting its destination. Core, archive, isocurve, wireframe and seven native 3DM fixtures pass.
trim_source_consistency_2026_11_13.remaining: The rule also reaches definition members via shared validation but those paths were not exercised. Desktop, legacy malformed-file recovery, all geometry-edit commands, native peak and large trim metadata remain open; Plan A remains open.
trim_source_consistency_2026_11_13.next_action: Design bounded large-trim representation and save/load admission; reconcile the debug adapter without disrupting active sessions.

trim_bounded_writer_2026_11_13.scope: The trim setter now serializes through a buffer bounded by the existing extension limit and stops before serializing an oversized payload. Exact-limit output matches the prior format; one-byte-short refusal preserves the prior entity. Four archive persistence tests, 14 semantic tests and seven native 3DM fixtures passed.
trim_bounded_writer_2026_11_13.remaining: The default 16 KiB limit still excludes larger trim sources. This bounds the setter serialization buffer, not native peak or all direct callers of to_extension. Desktop debug adapter mismatch, independent Rhino and large-trim save/load remain open; Plan A open and B deferred.
trim_bounded_writer_2026_11_13.next_action: Design trim-specific representation and admitted archive/scene/transaction handling; separately reconcile the debug adapter without disturbing active sessions.

trim_atomic_limit_2026_11_13.scope: A 28x28 trimmed surface exceeded the default 16 KiB extension limit during controller/document validation before native export. Previously the setter could install an oversized extension and report success. It now checks the limit before replacing metadata; a default-limit large-source fixture and an existing-metadata preservation fixture pass. Oversized extension validation checks size before parsing.
trim_atomic_limit_2026_11_13.remaining: Larger trim data remains unsupported at default limits. Scoped admission and compatible save/load must be designed; debug adapter mismatch, independent Rhino and native peak remain open. Plan A remains open; B deferred.
trim_atomic_limit_2026_11_13.next_action: Design a trim-specific bound and account for archive, transaction and decoding peaks before supporting larger metadata; separately reconcile the debug adapter.

large_trim_metadata_limit_2026_11_13.scope: A 28x28 trimmed plane with a hole failed controller/document validation after set_trimmed_surface returned success: the extension duplicates surface data and default max_name_bytes limits the payload to 16 KiB. The test did not reach the native adapter or export. The temporary failing test was removed after recording the result.
large_trim_metadata_limit_2026_11_13.remaining: Large trim metadata requires a separately budgeted representation or scoped limit and save/load compatibility; removing the export-only guard alone cannot solve the default workflow. Desktop debug adapter mismatch, independent Rhino, native transient peak and arbitrary trims remain open; Plan A open and B deferred.
large_trim_metadata_limit_2026_11_13.next_action: Design a bounded trim representation with save/load compatibility; separately reconcile the debug adapter without disrupting active sessions.
